messages:
ryan (SDK): planning a late change-window shadow publish tonight 00:30-01:30 PT for py/ts SDK 1.14.0-canary. question: do we unpin samples immediately or wait until promotion? want to avoid breaking pinned fleets.

jessica (DevEx): wait to unpin. recommended: shadow -> 24-48h -> soft-deprec old sync client with docs + samples pointing to >=1.14.0. don't yank. add console banner during soft-deprec.

omar (release-engineer): publish steps: build/sign/upload, tag canary. use:
```
./ci/publish.sh --canary --sign --tag canary
```
shadow routing: 5% -> 10% after first hour if smoke ok. promotion: retag canary->latest and promote.
rollback: unpublish canary tag and re-promote prior tag; if artifact compromised, republish previous sha as hotfix.

kai (QA): smoke list:
- pip/npm install from canary
- import client, basic generate, embeddings
- run smoke suites: `pytest tests/smoke.py::basic` + `npm run smoke`
I can be on call during window. will require latency + error < 0.5% to promote.

deploy-bot: job queued (jb-20240601-19). will post logs here.

marta (eng-manager): docs + support pinged. include migration snippets for sync->async and a one-line pin snippet for ops teams. Also ask billing to check any reserved fleets.

ryan (SDK): drafting changelog + migration PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432

deploy-bot: publish job started: build ok, sign ok, upload ok. artifact: @redwood/sdk@1.14.0-canary

kai (QA): installing from canary now, running smoke.

kai (QA): smoke passed locally. small uptick in tokenization latency for one region, monitoring. no functional regressions.

jessica (DevEx): telemetry flags set. prepare console banner draft. plan soft-deprec in 48h if no regressions.

deploy-bot: publish job succeeded. shadow routing set to 10%.

ryan (SDK): thanks. will merge changelog + docs PR, set soft-deprec message after 48h if clean.

marta (eng-manager): approved. coordinate partner comms after soft-deprec live.
